name: Consistencia de Piel del Cuello
algorithm: Neck Skin Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes neck skin characteristics for deepfake detection:

1. **Neck Región Segmentation**: The neck region is segmented — the area between the jawline and collar/clothing line. This region is forensically important as it lies at the boundary or outside the typical face-swap region.

2. **Rostro - Neck Piel Emparejamiento**: Skin characteristics (color, tone, texture, sun damage, aging) should be consistent between face and neck. The method compares skin properties across the face-neck boundary. Face-swap deepfakes may show mismatched skin between the generated face and original neck — different color temperature, different texture quality, or different aging characteristics.

3. **Neck Piel Textura Análisis**: Neck skin has characteristic texture: horizontal creases (neck lines), visible platysma muscle bands in some individuals, and different pore distribution than facial skin. The method evaluates whether neck texture is consistent with the face age and quality. AI-generated faces may show an unnatural transition at the jaw-neck boundary.

4. **Color Continuity Across Mandíbula**: The color transition from face to neck should be smooth and physically motivated (slightly different sun exposure). The method measures color discontinuity at the jawline. Deepfake blending often creates subtle but detectable color seams at this boundary.

5. **Temporal Neck - Rostro Coherencia**: Neck skin should respond to head motion consistently — rotating head reveals different neck surfaces, creates characteristic skin folds, and shows consistent skin tone from different angles. The method tracks neck-face coherence across frames. Deepfake face movement that doesn't correctly account for neck kinematics produces detectable inconsistencies.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante neck skin consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
